name: Bank of Qingdao Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Qingdao Co. Ltd. Engages in the provision of commercial banking services in China. It operates through the following segments: Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, Financial Market Business, and Un-allocated Items and Others. The Corporate Banking segment offers financial products and services to corporations, government agencies and financial institutions. The Retail Banking segment offers personal loans and deposit services to individual customers. The Financial Market Business segment is involved in inter-bank money market transactions, repurchase transactions, investments in debt securities, and non-standardized debt investments. The Un-allocated items & Others segment contains head office assets, liabilities, income and expenses. The company was founded on November 15, 1996, and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
